item.title: Ohio State Wide Receivers Coach Cortez Hankton Set to Make $900,000 in 2026, $1 Million in 2027
item.description: Cortez Hankton will make $900,000 in his first season as Ohio State's wide receivers coach. According to documents obtained by The Columbus Dispatch's Joey Kaufman, the new Ohio State wide receivers coach is set to make $900,000 in 2026 and $1 million in 2027. Compared to Ohio State's 2025 assistant coach salaries, Hankton's $900,000 salary exceeds those of quarterbacks coach Billy Fessler, linebackers coach James Laurinaitis, running backs coach Carlos Locklyn, and tight ends coach Keenan Baile

item.title: Ohio State To Wear Scarlet Jim Jackson-Era Throwback Uniforms Against UCLA On Saturday
item.description: Ohio State men's basketball will throw it back to the early 1990s on Saturday when the Buckeyes host UCLA at the Schottenstein Center. The Buckeyes will debut their scarlet Jim Jackson-era throwbacks during Saturday's matinee matchup against the Bruins. Ohio State donned these uniforms from 1987 through 1996, a period highlighted by the rise of Jackson and his historic All-American seasons in 1990-1991 and 1991-1992. item.title: John Mobley Jr. Drives Ohio State to Emphatic Win Over UCLA, 86-74
item.description: Every time Ohio State needed a basket, John Mobley Jr. delivered. At least, until the Buckeyes took over the game as a team against UCLA. Mobley racked up a career-high 28 points and six made 3-pointers to propel Ohio State (12-5, 4-3 Big Ten) to an 86-74 home victory over UCLA (12-6, 4-3) on Saturday. item.title: Penn State Transfer Puff Johnson Receives Temporary Restraining Order Allowing Him to Play for Ohio State
item.description: Ohio State will soon have a new player on its roster. Former Penn State and North Carolina guard Puff Johnson was granted a temporary restraining order against the NCAA by the Franklin County Court of Common Pleas on Friday, awarding him immediate eligibility to play for Ohio State this season.
